The season, which consists of two tournaments ([[Apertura and Clausura]]), began on 23 January and is scheduled to end on 29 November 2026. The fixture draw for both of the season's tournaments was held on 3 December 2025.{{cite web |title=Calendario listo para la temporada 2026 |url=https://www.apf.org.py/noticias/listo-calendario-para-la-temporada-2026 |publisher=[[Paraguayan Football Association]] |access-date=5 December 2025 |language=es |date=3 December 2025 |trans-title=Schedule set for the 2026 season}} In the Torneo Apertura [[Club Olimpia|Olimpia]] were the champions, clinching their forty-eighth league title with three matches in hand after a 1–1 draw with [[Sportivo Ameliano]] and a 2–1 loss for [[Cerro Porteño]] against [[Recoleta FC|Recoleta]] on 3 May.{{cite web |url=https://www.vssports.com.py/versus/2026/05/03/olimpia-arranca-el-punto-decisivo-y-es-el-nuevo-campeon/ |title=¡Olimpia arranca el punto decisivo y es el nuevo campeón! |trans-title=Olimpia pull up the decisive point and are the new champions! |publisher=Versus |language=es |date=3 May 2026 |access-date=3 May 2026}} Cerro Porteño entered the season as defending champions, having won the [[2025 Copa de Primera#Torneo Clausura|2025 Clausura]] tournament. ==Teams== Twelve teams compete in the season: the top ten teams in the relegation table of the [[2025 Copa de Primera#Relegation|2025 season]] and the top two teams in the [[2025 Paraguayan División Intermedia]]. ===Team changes=== [[Club General Caballero (Juan León Mallorquín)|General Caballero (JLM)]] and [[Club Atlético Tembetary|Tembetary]] were relegated to the second tier league [[Paraguayan División Intermedia|División Intermedia]] after ending in the bottom two places of the relegation table at the end of the 2025 season, and they were replaced by the 2025 División Intermedia champions [[Club Rubio Ñu|Rubio Ñu]] and runners-up [[Club Sportivo San Lorenzo|San Lorenzo]]. Rubio Ñu, who returned to the top flight after 8 years, clinched promotion with a 1–0 win over Sportivo Carapeguá on 14 September 2025,{{cite web|url=https://unicanal.com.py/deportes/luego-de-8-anos-rubio-nu-regresa-a-primera/ |title=Luego de 8 años, Rubio Ñu regresa a Primera |trans-title=Rubio Ñu return to ''Primera'' after 8 years |language=es |publisher=[[Unicanal]] |date=14 September 2025 |access-date=30 November 2025}} while San Lorenzo returned to the Copa de Primera for the first time since [[2020 Paraguayan Primera División season|2020]] by defeating Fernando de la Mora on 4 October 2025, the final matchday of the División Intermedia tournament.{{cite web|url=https://www.rdn.com.py/2025/10/05/sportivo-san-lorenzo-vuelve-a-la-primera-division/ |title=Sportivo San Lorenzo vuelve a la Primera División |trans-title=Sportivo San Lorenzo return to the First Division |language=es |publisher=RDN |date=5 October 2025 |access-date=30 November 2025}} {{col-begin|width=auto}} {{col-break}} {| class="wikitable" |- !
